optimizedDescription.value: ReadOnlyChangeView: shared read accessors for drafted/discarded; no mutate or Change unwrap.

optimizedContext.value:
# ReadOnlyChangeView

## Rules
- Shared accessors: `name`, `createdAt`, `description`, `state`, `specIds`, `workspaces`, `schemaName`, `schemaVersion`, `artifacts` (status/keys, not body), `history`.
- No mutating methods (`transition`, `updateSpecIds`, `draft`, `restore`, `discard`, `invalidate`, approval mutators, etc.).
- No public `change`/`unwrap`/`toChange` escape hatch. Only ChangeRepository internals + facade factory hold mutable aggregate.
- Internal facade implements Drafted+Discarded; factories: `toDraftedChangeView` (requires `isDrafted`), `toDiscardedChangeView` (latest event `discarded`). `getDraft`/`getDiscarded`/`list*` map via factories.
- Artifact body via `ChangeRepository.artifact` — not on view.

## Constraints
- Interface contract, not Change replacement. Active changes still use Change via get/mutate.
